_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score/F&G coil inside/near Complacency with no volatility-expansion breaker; crowded longs and dead ETF flows are stress under the range, not a confirmed down-rung yet.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly HOLD→Complacency; narrative is silent on forward phase but its long-skew extreme supports staying cautious rather than going LONG
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 47-54 and BTC/ETH stay rangebound without vol expansion or sustained ETF outflow acceleration
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks below ~46 on persistent zero/negative ETF flows and exchange inflows, or pushes above ~55 on renewed ETF demand and long-skew unwind
